thread:
james-acme: Hey @support — since last night our function/tool calls in JSON mode started returning 400 invalid_function_args. Example payload we send:
```json
{\"userId\": \"u-123\", \"orderId\": \"ord-456\", \"amount\": 100,}
```
Runtime error: `FunctionCallError: tool 'process_payment' missing required property 'user_id'`
We didn't change our client, this just started after a deploy. Saw one 401 earlier too. Running against us-west-2 hosted API. Any quick fix?

olivia-support: sorry about the trouble — can you paste the full curl (redact token) + the request-id header if available? Also which model/runtime version and are you explicitly enabling JSON mode (structured_output=true)?

james-acme: here's the repro curl (token redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call \ 
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" \ 
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \ 
  -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-chat-1\",\"input\":\"charge\",\"tool\":\"process_payment\",\"arguments\": {\"userId\": \"u-123\",\"orderId\":\"ord-456\",\"amount\":100,}}'
```
Request-id: `req_0a9f3b`
Model: rwd-chat-1, runtime: 2026-02-15, structured_output=true

olivia-support: got it, thanks. I can repro locally with your payload. Sharing with eng-oncall @miguel-oncall — leaving here for visibility. :eyes:

miguel-oncall: looking at the logs for req_0a9f3b — two things: 1) the JSON parser failed initially because of the trailing comma in the payload (`,` after 100) which yields a parse error in strict JSON mode; 2) after parse fixed, validation against the tool schema fails because our v2-tool-schema enforces snake_case keys (user_id, order_id). Previously we had a compatibility shim that accepted camelCase; it was toggled off in a recent validation hardening rollout for some orgs (your org got the toggle).
Workarounds: 
- Quick: remove trailing comma (client bug) and send snake_case keys (user_id, order_id)
- Immediate compat: set header `X-Infer-Compat: camelCase` or add query `?compat=camelCase` to bypass the strict schema for now (we can enable per-org).
I can flip a temporary compatibility flag for your org while we roll a safer migration. Will also add server-side normalization to avoid breaks. ETA ~24h.

miguel-oncall: also noticed repeated retries from your side caused extra failed invocations (spike in tokens). If you're using exponential retry with short backoff, please pause retries while we patch to avoid billing noise. We'll capture all failed request-ids for billing review.

janet-billing: filing a refund/credit review for req_0a9f3b and associated retries. @james-acme can you confirm approx number of retries you saw?

james-acme: thanks all — we had 3 automated retries from our webhook handler before we turned it off. We'll switch keys to snake_case and strip trailing commas on our side as immediate fix. Please flip the compat flag while you patch. Request id list: req_0a9f3b, req_0a9f3b-r1, req_0a9f3b-r2.

olivia-support: thanks @james-acme — i'm enabling the compat flag for your org now and will DM confirmation. I'll keep this thread updated once eng patches the server-side normalization. :thumbsup:

miguel-oncall: patched a short-term normalization on the edge to accept camelCase for the tool arg names and dropped strict parser enforcement for trailing commas for one hour to give customers breathing room. Long-term: we'll add explicit deprecation notice and a migration guide.

james-acme: confirmed requests succeed now after compat flag. Appreciated the quick turnaround.

olivia-support: closing loop — we'll follow up w/ a postmortem & migration doc in #docs once the long-term fix ships. If you see any more 401s, paste the request-id and I'll escalate. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
